## Profit By Project

Income, costs and labor by project for the months from `fromMonth` to `toMonth`. It reads every posted line on an income, cost-of-goods or expense account that names a project (the documents still posted as cards, and the journal months' lines in the period, the same reading as Profit and Loss by Class), and adds labor: each time activity in the period at its cost rate, by its project. Labor from time posts nothing; it counts here only.

```ts
import { ProfitByProject } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-dimensions';
```

`rows` holds each project's `incomeMinor`, `costMinor` (cost of goods and expenses), `laborMinor` and `profitMinor`; `profitMinor` on the card adds them up. Lines without a project aren't listed.

### Non-goals
No budget against actual by project.

### Example
`Reports/profit-by-project-2027-01`.
